notes_for_editor: One source: the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes two Missouri Conservation Commission annual reports (FY 1950-51 and FY 1953-54). The reports themselves were not reached. No design, height or removal date is given. A web search for Canaan returned only an unrelated Canaan Mountain lookout in West Virginia and a Canaan Township civil division in Gasconade County; neither was used. The story is short because the evidence is short. The bare 'Removed' label has no survey block beside it, so the story reads it as the lookout's own status.
